unit.why: A single anecdote about the young Rebbe of Rozdol: he declares an animal kosher, fears his ruling was wrong, and is vindicated by his master and by an overheard conversation.

stories.summary_en: In his youth the Rozdol rebbe declares kosher a Sabbath animal found with a needle in its intestines. Later he is terrified the meat was treif and waits anxiously for his master R. Zvi to finish the Minhah prayer. R. Zvi assures him that Heaven ruled the same way, and next morning he overhears two little girls revealing that one of them had hidden the needle there, confirming his ruling.
